Exceptional n=3 and n=4 inequalities are exact, and for all n>=5 the cubic coefficient positivity plus strict Bernoulli inequality gives the cube bound. The final logarithmic expansion gives the factorial-limit coefficient 1. Optional numerical direct hull integration for dimensions 3–6 and exact rational checker were executed; all passed. No finite check is used to infer an infinite claim.

value.rationale: Parity halfcubes are canonical type-D/Coxeter and S-hypersimplex polytopes of interest in polyhedral combinatorics. Their volume-uniform isotropic constant is a natural affine-invariant geometric quantity distinct from previously determined John/Löwner extrema. The complete high-dimensional profile has a rigid exceptional tetrahedral dimension and a sharp, rapidly decaying geometric deficit from the cube, including noncentrally symmetric odd dimensions outside standard symmetric cubical upper-bound classes. The exact infinite-family covariance and boundary classification are more informative than routine finite enumeration or arbitrary parameter slicing.
